name: How long does surface restoration take?

mainEntity.name: How long does surface restoration take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of surface restoration varies depending on the size of the area, the type of surface, and the extent of the damage. A small patio restoration might take a day or two, while a larger driveway or multiple surface projects could take several days to a week. We provide an estimated timeline with your project proposal and work efficiently to minimize disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Restoration time varies by project size and damage, from a few days for small projects to a week for larger ones.
